description: The organization's activity log, append-only and chained: who did what and through what (a person, an agent, the API, a task, while), filterable.

assignment.description: An assignment's history (its id): granted, revoked, expired, flagged, kept.

family.description: Families, separated by commas: deploy, data, security, access, permissions, approval, task, alert, connection, app, observation, loop (agents' wake-ups).

person.description: Address or name (partial) of the person, or "while".

resource.description: Text searched in the object ("carnet", "main.reservations"), or id or type of resource.

since.description: Start: 30m, 24h, 7d, a date (2026-10-18) or an ISO 8601 instant.

until.description: End, same format; a date alone counts the whole day.

verify.description: Check the log's chain instead of reading it.

who.description: An identity, written as for explain_access (what it did).

name: get_activity_log
title: Read the organization's activity log
